claves: Ovalado o casi esférico, de 40-60 por 30-50 µm (más chico que el de H. diminuta). En la membrana interna tiene dos polos de donde salen 4 a 8 filamentos polares, entre las dos membranas.

imagen.descripcionOriginal: This photomicrograph reveals ultrastructural details exhibited by a single Hymenolepis nana tapeworm ovum. H. nana eggs are oval, or subspherical in shape, and are 40µm-60µm X 30µm-50µm in size, which are smaller than those of H. diminuta. On the inner shell membrane, are two poles, from which 4-8 polar filaments spread out between its inner and outer shell membranes.
